components.description: The Ciurlionis mirror's composite: the AI output threshold-keyed on its luminance, capped by the matte (TD Minimum), and laid atop a painting loop chosen by Scene, brightened and scaled to cover the frame. TD's maths on sRGB-encoded 8-bit values between wgsl_encode* and wgsl_decode.
components.name: PaintingKey

definition.description: Luminance (sRGB-encoded) where the AI picture turns opaque.
definition.label: Threshold

definition.description: Width of the key's ramp. At 0.75 even black keeps about 40% cover.
definition.label: Soften

definition.description: Which painting loop: 0 shows painting0, 1 shows painting1 (TD switch2, driven by the scene clock).
definition.label: Scene

definition.description: The fitted painting, scaled about the centre (TD fit1 sx, sy).
definition.label: Scale

components.description: drmbt's TouchDesigner watercolor, operator for operator: a feedback loop that drifts along a noise flow field, bleeds uphill along its own soft-light slope, keeps the brighter of trail and grained input, and darkens one side of every stroke with an emboss. Runs TD's maths on sRGB-encoded 8-bit values between wgsl_encode and wgsl_decode; parameters keep drmbt's names and meanings.
components.name: Watercolor

definition.description: How far each frame of the trail falls back toward the grained input.
definition.label: Blend Original

definition.description: How fast the flow field evolves (noise z units per second).
definition.label: Speed

definition.description: How far the trail bleeds along its own slope each frame, in uv units.
definition.label: Displace Weight

definition.description: The emboss's flat value. 1 leaves only the darkened side.
definition.label: Midpoint

definition.description: TD's emboss direction: counter-clockwise from +x, y up.
definition.label: Direction

parameters.expressions: p3 = p3; p4 = p4; p5 = p5; p6 = p6; step_start = round(4 + 16 * p4); step_end = round(14 + 11 * p4)
hands = value; p3 = (1 - scene) * (1 - hands); p4 = (1 - scene) * hands; p5 = scene * (1 - hands); p6 = scene * hands; butterfly = (1 - scene) * hands
